heroLead: A private sailing experience for 2–3 guests, starting in Ystad in southern Sweden. You choose the number of days, islands, pace and style — then plan it together with the captain.
flexTitle: Create the journey you actually want
flexText: Go for one day, a week, ten days or longer. Combine more sailing, more island time, historic towns, fishing, nature or quiet rest. The duration, route and programme are all open for discussion and tailored to your group.
card1p: A day, a weekend, a week or several weeks — according to your time and ambitions.
card2p: Bornholm, Sweden’s south coast, Danish harbours and small Baltic islands.
card3p: More sailing or more time ashore — we decide together.
galleryTitle: The yacht, the sea and places we have actually visited
yachtText: A 9.5-metre sailing yacht built for real cruising, not only a short harbour trip. The captain sleeps in the separate aft cabin, leaving the main accommodation for the guests.
yacht4: Separate aft cabin for the captain
routeTitle: There is no single correct itinerary
routeText: We start in Ystad and select the destination according to the duration, your interests and the weather. Destinations are possibilities, not rigid promises.
route1p: Colourful harbours, cliffs, fishing villages and compact historic towns.
route2p: Shorter passages, coastal towns, lighthouses and quiet marinas.
route3p: A journey of several weeks, with additional islands or countries, can also be discussed.
weatherKicker: When the Baltic changes the plan
weatherTitle: Weather is part of the journey
weatherText: Safety comes before the itinerary. When conditions do not allow safe sailing, the programme can move ashore, with accommodation in a seaside house in Gislövshammar or an apartment in Ystad, depending on availability and the agreed plan.
weatherQuote: Weather may change the route — it does not have to ruin the holiday.
priceTitle: Seven private days for your group
priceText: These are example prices for seven days. A shorter or longer journey is priced separately once the programme is agreed.
includedP: Yacht, captain, fuel, normal marina fees, safety equipment and alternative accommodation within the agreed programme when weather prevents safe sailing.
notIncludedP: Flights, travel to Ystad, food and drinks, restaurants, personal insurance, paid attractions and private expenses.
captainText: I am an Israeli citizen, speak Russian and spend the sailing season in southern Sweden. I sail this yacht myself and know the changing character of the Baltic. Before booking, we have a video call to meet and make sure the format suits everyone.
contactTitle: Tell me what your ideal journey looks like
contactText: Write how many guests are travelling, how many days you have and what you would like to experience. We will build a realistic programme together and check available dates.
